[[Sloka Stadium|Slokas stadions]] (former) | capacity = | chairman = | Team Manager = | manager = | league = [[Latvian First League|1. līga]] | website = [https://web.archive.org/web/20180314101548/https://www.fkkauguri.lv/ fkkauguri.lv]| }} '''FK Kauguri/PBLC Jūrmala''' was a [[Latvia|Latvian]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club located in [[Kauguri, Jūrmala]] [[Jūrmala]].{{Cite web |title=FK Kauguri |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefafutsalchampionsleague/clubs/2600225--fk-kauguri/ |access-date=November 9, 2025 |website=UEFA}}{{Cite web |title=FK Kauguri |url=https://lff.lv/klubi/fk-kauguri-37110/?cid=14970337 |access-date=November 9, 2025 |website=Latvijas Futbola federācija |language=Latvian}} The clubs origins come from the youth academy '''JFC Kauguri''' (Jūrmalas futbola centrs "Kauguri"), founded in 1999, before it merged with [[FK Multibanka Rīga]] in 2008 to form '''JFC Kauguri/Multibanka'''.{{Cite web |title=Kauguri, Jūrmalas Futbola Centrs |url=https://www.firmas.lv/en/companies/kauguri-jurmalas-futbola-centrs/40008039869 |access-date=2026-08-04 |website=www.firmas.lv |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Schöggl |first=Hans |date=6 May 2011 |title=Latvia - List of Foundation Dates |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesl/letfound.html |website=RSSSF (Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation)}} Later, with the departure of the main sponsor, ''Multibanka'' bank, and the arrival of a new one - construction company ''PBLC'' - the name was changed to FK Kauguri-PBLC. The team played most of its [[Latvian First League]] matches at [[Sloka Stadium]] or, at times, the Kauguri Secondary School stadium. The club was dissolved in 2010 due to a failure to find partners and sponsors, likely due to the ''PBLC'' company entering administration and later going bankrupt.{{Cite web |date=2010-02-04 |title=Klubs "Kauguri/PBLC" vairs nepastāv |url=https://sportacentrs.com/futbols/1_liga/04022010-klubs_kauguri_pblc_vairs_nepastav |access-date=2026-08-04 |website=Sportacentrs.com |language=lv}} [[File:JFC Kauguri Jūrmala logo.svg|thumb|Former crest as JFC Kauguri Jūrmala]]"}}
